ownership_policy: Human-owned and version-controlled. Agents may propose changes only through a human-reviewed pull request.

worker.name: Hermes
worker.role: Execute bounded repository work and return evidence
worker.repository_access: Local write access when explicitly authorized

judge.name: ChatGPT-5 Sol
judge.role: Independently inspect evidence, assess architecture, and issue verdicts
judge.repository_access: Connector capability does not authorize implementation unless the repository owner explicitly requests it

stable_governance.human_authority: The repository owner approves consequential architecture, merge, release, and environment changes.

host.memory: Approximately 13 GiB visible to Linux; no guest swap

security_rules: Never commit credentials, tokens, private transcripts, or unrelated personal files.
Treat technical access as capability, not authorization.
Verify live repository and environment state before consequential work.
Use placeholders for credentials in documentation.
drift_policy: Update the snapshot through a human-reviewed pull request when material host, toolchain, model, limit, or responsibility boundaries change.
